claims.statement: The operator application always mounts workspace, report, Content Studio, and research-automation read applications, but creates owner, content-owner, and research-generation write applications only when owner writes are enabled; an enabled owner executor also acquires the executor lock and may sweep abandoned content AI attempts at startup.

The workspace API is a GET-only, query-only SQLite projection that replays and verifies workspace artifacts and lineage; malformed or failed verification is returned as a generic integrity error rather than a partial workspace view.

Discovery workspace creation snapshots a validated request into a canonical artifact and immutable metadata, permits an identical workspace-key retry, and rejects reuse of that key with changed content.

The owner API composes the workspace progression so that a product workspace is created only from a verified B7 PASS, while B8 clearance, B9 working/lock, and B10 decisions enforce their referenced workspace, clearance, revision, and lock identities.
An analysis-backed proposal is persisted as PROPOSED only after verified audit evidence links are validated, including that each link's use is permitted by the corresponding audit assessment.

Governed proposal review requires a trusted actor with the proposal-review capability, records actor and policy identity in an immutable decision, and allows only initial PROPOSED decisions or a subsequent decision after HOLD.

Approved-proposal intake creates an AUTHORIZED_PLAN only when the supplied decision is the exact current effective APPROVED decision for the proposal; the plan pins proposal/decision artifacts, authorization identity, and producer metadata, and requests define_manual_tasks rather than embedding execution work.

Report and report-review-target reads are query-only; owner creation of a review target validates the exact report, report version, interpretation, and intended-use request before creating and rereading a receipt.

Research automation separates its query-only read service from an owner-side writer and worker; mutation routes require owner configuration, exact origin, and bearer authorization, and model coding proposals explicitly do not themselves wake report generation.

Content Studio exposes verified query-only read paths separately from owner-authenticated content writes, and its campaign-insight lock requires B10 approval when the campaign is linked to a research product.

A Content Studio creative-AI operation records a running attempt before one gateway dispatch, validates and stores output before dependent persistence, closes it as succeeded or failed without automatic retry, and can mark still-running attempts interrupted on executor restart.

The React console distinguishes demo from real mode, loads and cross-validates real workspace projections, reloads after owner mutations or conflicts, and obtains an automatic owner token only in the explicitly flagged local-test mode.

The operator app always mounts workspace, report, Content Studio, and research read applications, but mounts owner write applications only when owner writes are enabled; only the owner-capable process takes the executor lock and sweeps running Content Studio AI attempts at startup.

Workspace reads use a read-only SQLite connection with query_only enabled and reconstruct verified workspace, candidate, basket, product, clearance, B9, and B10 projections; any verification exception is returned as a generic integrity error.

DiscoveryWorkspaceService persists an ACTIVE canonical workspace artifact and immutable row transactionally, accepts a repeated workspace key only for the same request identity, and verifies artifact bytes and immutable metadata on reads.

Analysis-backed proposals are tied to a verified evidence audit, and governed proposal decisions require an application-verified actor with governance:proposal-review and allow only PROPOSED-to-APPROVED, REJECTED, or HOLD transitions followed by HOLD-to-APPROVED or REJECTED.

ApprovedProposalIntakeService creates an AUTHORIZED_PLAN only when the supplied decision is the exact current effective APPROVED decision for the supplied proposal, and the resulting plan pins the proposal, decision, actor, policy, timestamp, producer, and define_manual_tasks next step.

ReportReviewTargetLedgerService deterministically builds a review target from the requested report version, interpretation, and intended use, persists it transactionally, and rereads it by rebuilding and checking row identity, retained bytes, manifest metadata, and digest.

A Content Studio AI attempt commits a running row before exactly one gateway dispatch, validates and registers output before dependent persistence, closes as succeeded or failed without automatic retry, and can be swept to interrupted after restart.

ResearchAutomationService start verifies the workspace before writing a queued run and its steps, while an absent keyword-draft transport produces an explicit unavailable result rather than invoking a model.
